name: elagoht/redirects
description: A collage plugin for redirects kept in a file rather than in code: what a site migration leaves behind, hundreds of old addresses and where each one went.

config.description: A collage plugin for redirects kept in a file rather than in code: what a site migration leaves behind, hundreds of old addresses and where each one went.

file.description: File is the redirects file's name. Default "redirects.txt".

noRedirectsFile.description: NoRedirectsFile leaves out /_redirects, the copy of the rules a static host reads.

rules.description: Rules are redirects given in Go or configuration, checked after the file's.

from.description: From is the old path: "/about-us", or a prefix, "/blog/*", matching "/blog", "/blog/" and everything under it.

status.description: Status is 301, the default, 302, 307, 308, or 410 for a page that is gone and has no replacement.

to.description: To is where it went: a path on the site or an absolute URL. For a prefix, ":splat" in it is what the "*" matched. "-" for a rule that is gone.
